text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo conquers the Japan Derby! 
Cheers erupt over the monumental victory. 
However, the joy is short-lived—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, it was discovered that 
Tokai Teio had suffered a bone fracture. 
While running in the Kikuka Sho looked 
grim, her team announced they would not 
give up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
All Twin Turbo and the others can do is 
believe in her and get stronger. They keep 
blazing ahead toward autumn.
